summary: Perfect Accounting & Tax Services is a small, fast-growing CPA-led practice headquartered in Direk, Adelaide, with Sydney and Melbourne offices, led by Director Faisal Abbas. It publishes frequent articles on AI-driven automation, reconciliation and virtual CFO work, with a stated human-led approach and a strong emphasis on traceable reconciliations. Its bookkeeping runs on Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks.

claims.text: LinkedIn data shows the firm founded in 2019 with 10-20 employees, up 80% year on year, with a workforce spread across Pakistan, Canada and Australia.
claims.quote: Perfect Accounting & Tax Services has 10-20 employees (+80% YoY), founded in 2019.

claims.text: On 4 Nov 2026 the firm published how it assesses a bookkeeping company for AI risk, warning that a bank-feed dashboard can create false confidence if reconciliations remain incomplete.
claims.quote: A dashboard showing current bank feeds can create false confidence if reconciliations remain incomplete or suspense accounts continue growing.

claims.text: In the same article the firm says corrections should stay traceable rather than disappear into an unexplained final balance.
claims.quote: Corrections should remain traceable rather than disappearing into an unexplained final balance.

claims.text: The article asks AI bookkeeping providers for reconciliation reports and exception queues as evidence, and separates deterministic rules from AI-generated recommendations.
claims.quote: We also distinguish deterministic rules from AI-generated recommendations.

claims.text: The firm says its model is human-led automation: technology handles speed and pattern recognition while accountants handle interpretation and strategy.
claims.quote: In practice, the best model is human-led automation.

claims.text: The firm's July 2026 month-end article argues that real-time reconciliation shifts the close from a clean-up exercise to a confirmation exercise.
claims.quote: This shifts the close from a clean-up exercise to a confirmation exercise.

claims.text: The firm says it would recommend strengthening the core finance function before a Virtual CFO if bank reconciliations are late.
claims.quote: if bank reconciliations are late, source documents are incomplete, payroll is inconsistent

claims.text: The firm offers Virtual CFO services for company directors, property groups, professional firms and high-net-worth individuals.
claims.quote: For company directors, property groups, professional firms and high-net-worth individuals, that shift can determine whether growth is controlled or merely busy.

claims.text: The firm uses Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks and BGL for SMSF in its bookkeeping work.
claims.quote: Using Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks, and BGL for SMSF, we keep your books clean, accurate, and future-ready

claims.text: In Nov 2026 the firm published a Xero, MYOB or QuickBooks comparison saying bank feeds and reconciliation tools reduce repetitive handling if coding remains controlled.
claims.quote: Bank feeds and reconciliation tools can reduce repetitive handling, provided transaction matching and coding remain controlled.

hooks.text: The firm's 4 Nov 2026 AI-risk article insists on traceable corrections, reconciliation reports and exception queues, and warns bank-feed dashboards can hide incomplete reconciliations: this is Vert's positioning (traceable, does not guess).
Virtual CFO articles state reconciliations must be current before CFO work; reconciliation prep is the bottleneck to its advisory offer.
Human-led automation is the firm's stated model, so a reviewer-in-the-loop product fits.

risks.text: The firm already publicly claims AI-driven processes and may have its own tooling or a competing vendor; much of its content reads as templated marketing so the articles may not be written by Faisal himself.
Firm is tax-led with a high-volume, low-price consumer tax return side; Virtual CFO focus is a smaller part.

gaps: No job ads found for the firm.
No podcast, video, Facebook or Instagram content from Faisal Abbas found; LinkedIn activity is firm-page posts.
Exact AI or reconciliation tools used by the firm are not named; only Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks and BGL.
No news coverage or awards found.

first.subject: Traceable reconciliation at Perfect Accounting
first.body:

Your November piece on assessing a bookkeeping company for AI risk warns that a bank-feed dashboard can create false confidence if reconciliations are incomplete. It reconciles and cash codes with a traceable audit trail and flags what it cannot match instead of guessing, so hours of manual reconciliation become minutes with a reviewer still signing off. You describe human-led automation as the best model. Open to a 10 min walkthrough this week?

Best,
